subject.title: Skill publish slugs still collide globally despite publisher scoping

question: Should maintainers close this issue as fixed for ClawHub publishing, or split the June 30 installed-skill UI ambiguity into a separate OpenClaw-scoped issue?
rationale: The source and release evidence are strong for the original publish bug, but collaborator-authored items must stay open and the later UI symptom may not belong in this ClawHub issue.

options.title: Close publish bug, split UI symptom
options.body: Close this as implemented by the owner-scoped ClawHub publish work and track the later OpenClaw UI ambiguity separately if it still reproduces.

options.title: Keep as umbrella
options.body: Keep this issue open to cover both publish and installed-skill ambiguity, but clarify that remaining work is no longer the ClawHub publish path.

recommendation.title: Close publish bug, split UI symptom
recommendation.body: Close this as implemented by the owner-scoped ClawHub publish work and track the later OpenClaw UI ambiguity separately if it still reproduces.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick authored the merged owner-scoped slug implementation and is the collaborator-author of the current issue.
